notes: No missing images, JavaScript errors, document horizontal overflow or fixed-container text clipping in the initial 24 samples.
Desktop short-height content uses an internal scrollbar where needed; mobile pages scroll naturally and keep footer actions reachable.
Root corrected button, tab and portrait skins from full-image stretching to declared nine-slice rendering, and repaired narrow search/metric labels.
Final focused screenshots checked at native display scale: primary centres are jade-filled with legible cream text; 320px overview title balances to two lines and quick-entry labels remain intact.
